opening.text: Regime is a clean alt bull. BTC $79,838, flat on the day but +23% over thirty. Dominance 59.2% and drifting lower - capital is leaving the majors for the tail. Fear & Greed 73, Greed. Book marks at $1,289 against $1,153 of cost - up $137, or 11.9%. UNI is the standout at +115.9%, $3.32 to $7.17, and it added 35.9% this week alone; the double is not the exit, it is the entry to the part that matters. ZEC +30.6% in three days, up 21% today and 143% on the month - the privacy cohort is in a real mania and we ride it rather than fade it. LINK is the largest line at $393, +12.6% in eight days. Nothing broken. Zero sells.

Deployed the last of the powder into NEAR - $100 market, roughly 40.25 units at $2.4607, $0.95 taker fee, validated against the broker. Six of seven lenses: +31.2% on the week, turnover a healthy 0.19 of cap, AI-L1 narrative, violent relative strength against BTC's +1.7% week, rank #33 with headroom, no overlap with anything held. The one miss is that it is up 13% today and we are paying up. Passed on XMR at 4/7 - turnover of 0.01 is a trap door, and stacking privacy behind a ZEC position already up 30% is concentration wearing conviction's coat.

Buying power falls to about $5 after the NEAR fill. That is the binding constraint now: fully invested, no dry powder, no bid to offer a drawdown. ADA is the weak link at +9.6% over thirty days against a book averaging far more, and it went nowhere today - on watch, not on the block. The plan is unchanged: hold everything, sell only on a broken thesis, let the winners run to absurdity.
